title: fix(react): an inline action's description locale map shows in the user's language in the param dialog
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTgVLHkF4YWMWPeXEgkyBS3)_
Fixes #29249

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：页面上内联动作（`element:button`）的 `description` 写成多语言 map 时，控制台在弹出参数对话框之前先把它折成当前语言的那一句。没写 `description` 的动作不受影响，对话框照旧显示「请填写以下信息以继续操作。」。
- 为什么改：cloud#3281 您裁定 A，契约半张（#29369）已落地，允许内联动作写 `description`。这是 UI 半张：不折的话，云端「邀请成员」对话框收到的是一个对象而不是一句话，邀请人看不到用自己语言写的说明。
- 风险与回滚：只在动作文案本地化器里多认一个键，与 `confirmText`、`errorMessage` 同一条处理；纯字符串和 `template` 信封原样返回，不读翻译包。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts`（`DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` 一行与文档注释），`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/element-button-paramDialogDescription-29249.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useActionTextLocalizer.description-29249.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/element-button-paramDialogDescription-29249.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件、9 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts`: `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` gains `description`, so a declared `description` goes through `collapseCopy` like `confirmText`, `successMessage` and `errorMessage`. An `I18nLabel` locale map becomes the active language's string; a `{ dialect: 'template', source }` envelope and a plain string come back as themselves. The `ActionTextLocalizer` type docblock and the module docblock's bullet list now name `description` with the other declared copy, and a new bullet records that it is collapse-only.
- Collapse-only, per the ruling: no bundle read for `description` in this hook. The param-collection host (`useConsoleActionRuntime`) still resolves `_actions.NAME.description` through `actionDescription` over the string it is handed.
- An action with no `description` gains no key, so the dialog keeps its generic line.
- `.changeset/29249-inline-action-description-locale.md`: `@object-ui/react: patch`.
- No exported type or signature changes; `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` is module-private.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useActionTextLocalizer.description-29249.test.tsx` (6 cases, real `I18nProvider`): a nameless inline action's zh-CN/en map gives the zh-CN string under zh-CN and the English string under en; a named action collapses the map and does not read a bundle `description` entry (positive control: the same bundle node's `label` is read); a `template` envelope comes back as the same object; a plain string comes back unchanged; no `description` adds no key, nameless or named.
- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/element-button-paramDialogDescription-29249.test.tsx` (3 cases): the registered `element:button`, the real localizer and the real `ActionRunner` behind `ActionProvider` open the param dialog. A zh-CN/en `description` map shows the zh-CN string under zh-CN and the English string under en, and the runner hands the host one string. With no `description` the dialog shows 「请填写以下信息以继续操作。」. Each case first asserts the dialog opened with the action's title.
- Reverse check: with `description` removed from `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty), the five map cases go red and the four controls (envelope, plain string, no description x2) stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- The dialog in the components test is the test's own host, drawn with this package's `Dialog`, because `@object-ui/components` cannot import `@object-ui/app-shell`. It draws the line the way `ActionParamDialog` does (`state.description || t('actionDialog.description')`, `ActionParamDialog.tsx` line 691).
- Named inline actions: `element:button` forwards `name`, and the console's param handler calls `actionDescription(objForI18n, action?.name, action?.description)` for every dispatch (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` line 337), so a named inline action's bundle `description` is resolved there. Measured by reading; no finding.
- The same collapse now applies wherever the localizer runs (`DeclaredActionsBar`, `ObjectView`, `RecordDetailView`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`, `containers.tsx`, `record-quick-actions`, `record-related-list`), so a registered action's locale-map `description` reaches its dialog as a string too. The contract review of #29369 named that as the same pre-existing gap.
- The comment above the localizer call in `elements.tsx` still lists `label`, `confirmText`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage` as the localized copy. It is outside this card's file surface and was left as is; comment only.
